Resource guide and provenance

Use these files to understand the existing identity and accepted academic concepts. The new W catalogue supplies missing workflows and current academic-only scope. Resources are not an instruction to recreate the broader historical product.

ResourceHow to use it
design-system/tokens.css and components.cssOriginal shared palette, typography, controls and web/iPhone styling. Copy/adapt the web rules into the new design. iPhone-specific rules are references only.
academic-source/batch01/Original student course, assignment, upload/receipt and feedback renderer examples.
academic-source/batch02/Access/onboarding and instructor content, assignment, quiz, resource and rubric examples.
academic-source/batch03/Original course discussion/calendar/activity and grading/release examples.
academic-source/batch04/Course people/permissions, copy and insights examples. Academic scheduling-office sources are excluded.
legacy-academic-map.json32 historical academic S/P entries. Their states/labels are earlier planning context, not evidence the new W features were implemented.
historical-prototype.htmlThe original complete offline click-through prototype. It includes eight roles and campus scope. Review its student/instructor/TA views for visual continuity; do not copy the campus/admin navigation into the new app.
history/decisions.mdHistorical D1-D65, including later acceptance and delegation. Earlier draft comments are retained as history. New WD defaults live in the new decision register.
history/state_checklist.md and history/CONTRACT.mdEarlier state/integrity requirements. Plain-text source paths inside these records refer to the original project.
original-review/academic-scope-review.mdDerived readable coworker review. Original relative source links are rendered as original-path labels to avoid false package links; the local-machine PDF path is removed.
sample-assets/Newly authored fictional handout, individual/group specimen PDFs, work text and SVG preview; local placeholders with accessible text equivalents. PDF assets are frozen samples, not regenerated by the documentation builder.
provenance.jsonOriginal project path, original SHA-256 and included path for each selected resource, with transformations explicitly recorded.

Selected JS files are a source reading collection, not a standalone runnable build. Their original batch loader/build chain and other domains are intentionally not included. The historical HTML prototype is already self-contained. Create the new prototype from the W specification and fixtures instead of trying to execute a partial historical source collection.

No third-party logos, photographs, commercial icon pack or proprietary software binary is required. The copy contains project-owned reference material and newly authored fictional sample assets; linked vendor/standards documentation remains online with its publisher. This is not a redistribution of third-party help-center pages.

The original coworker PDF/screenshots and interview workbook are not included. Do not infer completed customer discovery from the research packet. No real tool license, customer, uploaded academic record or institutional integration is represented by the fixtures.
